interface vlan 99

ip ospf passive-interface enable
!
interface vlan 10
ip address 10.1.10.2 255.255.255.0
ip ospf cost 10
!
router ospf 1 router-id 10.1.10.2
network 10.1.10.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.1
network 10.1.99.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.1
!
storm-control detection enable
transceiver ddm enable
lldp enable
spanning-tree enable
spanning-tree priority 8192
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server access circuit read internet usm authpriv
snmp-server user monitor authentication sha <secret:SWITCH_SNMP_AUTH> privacy aes128 <secret:SWITCH_SNMP_PRIVACY>
snmp-server group circuit user monitor usm
snmp-server access-list 1000
